name: Hanze University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences university in Groningen with project-based degrees for clients, from business and engineering to a conservatoire and art academy.

ib.text: The IB Diploma meets the HAVO-level entry for 4-year programmes and counts as VWO-level for the 3-year ones. It also exempts you from the English test.

dates.label: General application deadline, non-EU students (September 2027 start)
General application deadline, EU students (September 2027 start)

programmes.name: Applied Computer Science
programmes.about: Software that runs on devices, machines and systems rather than only on screens: the programme combines software and hardware over four years, moving from foundations to a specialisation and professional practice.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August.

programmes.name: Classical Music
programmes.ib: Prince Claus Conservatoire; taught in Dutch and English. Audition (video pre-selection for violin, voice, piano); apply by 1 March in 2026, 2027 date not yet published.
programmes.about: Train as a versatile classical performer and teacher on one of some two dozen instruments or voice, with orchestra and chamber-music stage experience, pedagogy, entrepreneurship and work placements.
programmes.selectionNote: Motivation letter; video pre-selection for violin, voice and piano; then a live audition in Groningen with a theory test. 2026 deadline 1 March; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Creative Media & Game Technologies
programmes.ib: Maths required with a pass (Hanze sets no IB level). An online personality survey (MPT) within 10 working days of applying is compulsory.
programmes.about: Design and build games and interactive experiences with Unity, Unreal Engine, AR/VR and virtual production, learning through projects for real clients rather than exams.

needs.note: A pass on your final results; Hanze sets no IB level. The OMPT-A maths test (55%) can make up for it.

programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. An online Multicultural Personality Test is compulsory.

programmes.name: Design
programmes.ib: Minerva Art Academy; taught in Dutch and English. Portfolio, then home assignment and interview; portfolio due 1 June in 2026, 2027 date not yet published.
programmes.about: A broad design degree: in the first year you try all six majors (graphic & interaction, illustration & animation, spatial, time-based, product, OffRoad) before choosing one, working through studio, lab and theory classes.
programmes.selectionNote: Round 1: portfolio with motivation and CV (1 June in 2026). Round 2: home assignment and a 10-minute online interview. 2027 date not yet published.

programmes.name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering
programmes.ib: Maths required (Hanze sets no IB level).
programmes.about: Design, build and programme electronic solutions in hands-on projects for real clients, specialising from year 3 in Mechatronics, Sensors & Smart Systems or Energy & Power Electronics.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. Applying from May on, a non-binding Study Choice Check is compulsory.

programmes.name: Fine Art
programmes.ib: Minerva Art Academy; taught in Dutch and English. Portfolio, motivation letter and CV uploaded in Hanze Apply by 1 June 2027, then an admission interview.
programmes.about: A studio-based route to becoming an independent visual artist, where making and thinking go together across media, with tutors who are practising artists and options for exchange, minors and research projects.
programmes.selectionNote: Round 1: one PDF with portfolio, motivation letter and CV by 1 June 2027. Round 2: home assignment and a 10-minute online interview with two tutors and a student.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.ib: IB Diploma holders may take the 3-year version instead. Applying from May on means a compulsory Study Choice Check.

family.name: International Business
family.differs: The four-year BBA. Hanze says IB Diploma holders may take the 3-year version instead.
family.cardLine: Also open to you; a year longer

programmes.about: Business fundamentals (marketing, finance, supply chain, HR) with a compulsory year abroad: a semester at one of 120+ partner universities plus an international placement, and a foreign language from five.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. Applying from May on, a non-binding Study Choice Check is compulsory.

programmes.name: International Business (3-year)
programmes.ib: For VWO-level diplomas such as the IB Diploma. Applying from May on means a compulsory Study Choice Check.

family.name: International Business
family.differs: The three-year BBA, for VWO-level diplomas such as the IB Diploma.
family.cardLine: Open to you with the IB Diploma

programmes.about: The same International Business degree compressed into three years for pre-university diplomas, with a compulsory year abroad (partner-university semester and international internship) and a heavier self-study load.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. Applying from May on, a non-binding Study Choice Check is compulsory.

programmes.name: International Communication
programmes.about: How stories, news and campaigns shape opinion: PR and marketing, crisis communication and public affairs, consultancy and media writing, with a second year spent as a consultant on real client briefs.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August.

programmes.name: International Facility Management
programmes.about: How organisations run their services and spaces: semesters alternate between services and (work)space management, with hospitality, health and sustainability in view. One of two English-taught FM degrees in the Netherlands.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. A February start is also possible, with an earlier deadline.

programmes.name: International Finance & Control
programmes.about: Business finance for international organisations: a first year of financial and economic basics, then business economics and information provision, practised in projects for real clients.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August.

programmes.name: Jazz
programmes.ib: Prince Claus Conservatoire; taught in Dutch and English. Video pre-selection, then audition; apply by 1 March in 2026, 2027 date not yet published.
programmes.about: Become a professional jazz musician through weekly lessons with Dutch and international jazz players, with performance on stage from the first year alongside theory.
programmes.selectionNote: Motivation letter and three pre-selection videos, then a live audition in Groningen with a group theory test. 2026 deadline 1 March; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Marketing Management
programmes.about: Find out what customers need and want and how to win them for a brand, through theory and project work for real companies in an international classroom.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. EU/EEA: apply in Studielink by 15 August. From May on a selection check is compulsory; its advice is not binding.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.ib: VWO-level entry: Maths and Physics "at advanced level" (Hanze gives no HL/SL rule). EU applicants apply by 1 July.
programmes.about: A three-year engineering bachelor built on real projects from day one, which gives direct entry to Hanze's European Master in Renewable Energy or Smart Systems Engineering: an MSc in four and a half years.

needs.note: Hanze asks for maths "at advanced level" (VWO) and gives no IB HL/SL rule.
Hanze asks for physics "at advanced level" (VWO) and gives no IB HL/SL rule.

programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the VWO-level entry with maths and physics and you are admitted. EU/EEA applicants must meet the requirements by 1 July.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.ib: Selective: apply by 15 January 2027, then a registration form, online tests and an online selection day (10 February). HAVO-level entry; no subjects required.
programmes.about: Help people with movement problems move well again, combining medical-biological knowledge, treatment methods, behavioural psychology, communication and entrepreneurship, with much practice on peers and in clinics.
programmes.selectionNote: Selective: registration form and online motivation and learning-styles test by 10 Feb, then a test on lecture material at an online selection day. Ranking in mid-April.

programmes.name: Popular Culture
programmes.ib: Minerva Art Academy; taught in Dutch and English. Portfolio with a one-minute video, then an admission assessment; 2027 admission dates not yet published.
programmes.about: Make interdisciplinary performance work for audiences as a performer, writer/composer or visualiser/designer, learning in a production-house model with cultural institutions in Leeuwarden.
programmes.selectionNote: Portfolio showing some cultural experience plus a one-minute video, then an admission assessment day. 2026 had monthly rounds March to August; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Sport Studies
programmes.ib: VWO-level entry (IB Diploma). Apply by 15 June; online matching day and a sports medical fitness test.
programmes.about: A three-year degree on the role of sport in health, the economy and society, working on real challenges with professional sports organisations throughout.
programmes.selectionNote: Binding: a motivation letter and online matching day, then a sports medical fitness test (about €190); both must be positive. Apply by 15 June.

notes: The Prince Claus Conservatoire and Minerva Art Academy are part of Hanze: you apply through Studielink, but an audition or portfolio decides, with earlier deadlines.
With an IB Diploma you can take the 3-year International Business, Mechanical Engineering or Sport Studies, which are meant for VWO-level students.
Popular Culture is taught in Leeuwarden, not Groningen.
